title: FSMA 204 Receiving Event
description: Source Pydantic: api/app/models/starfish_events.py::ReceivingEvent. Rules: FSMA_COMMON_001, FSMA_RECEIVING_001-002. The data-model.md FSMA_RECEIVING_001 rule allows `received_at` OR `ship_to`, but the v1 Pydantic model only declares `received_at` (required). The schema reflects v1 behaviour — if v2 reintroduces `ship_to` as an alternative, change the `required` list to use `anyOf`.
